## Outcome and ownership

G-01b endpoint-selection contract implementation prerequisite; POAM-009 remains open. Driver: SWAG implementation session. Baseline: public main `291fee511887932572ecc9935e9786e098727677`, with PR196's exact proposed contract `db0ae5927848a87a674616f91f5bd06d09778f32` integrated. Land PR196 first. No runtime dependency on PR188.

## Change brief

The current contract has no decoder that binds an endpoint choice to the actual endpoint configuration and a bounded set of engine-supplied candidates. Implement a distinct choice/allowance contract with strict bounded decoding, explicit abstention, source-configuration digest binding and per-candidate declared effort support. It grants no authority: eligible candidate construction, authenticated packet/admission, real capability verification and dispatch remain engine work. Do not overload RouteStepDecision or register a placeholder operation.

Exact scope: new `crates/transport/rrd-contract/src/endpoint_selection.rs`, exports in `lib.rs`, focused tests using retained real configuration/output evidence with explicitly labelled denial mutations, a command-line verification example if needed for real endpoint proof, the owning inference reference/status and one immutable Gate G journal plus generated navigation. Reuse EndpointConfiguration/Profile, CanonicalId, digest validation and existing resource ceilings. No provider/model names, rankings or endpoints in implementation code; all supplied through arguments/configuration. No invented training/evaluation data, authorization claims, outputs or metrics.

Inspected: existing endpoint binding/configuration and router contracts, task/budget types, public catalogue configuration entries, engine endpoint configuration/inference boundary, PR196's specification, Gate G and POAM-009. Existing helpers and the three routing decisions remain unchanged. No runtime lifecycle, network call, credential resolver, scheduler, durable record or API registration is introduced by the pure contract package.

## Proof and limits

First oracle: the current contract cannot decode/validate actual endpoint-selection output against the retained installed endpoint configuration. Establish live output evidence separately from validation; do not fabricate provider results or human labels. Tests must reject changed profile/service identity, duplicate/foreign candidates, unknown effort, invalid/oversized output and mismatched configuration before a usable choice is returned. A supported choice is still not permission to execute it. Unknown capability facts remain unknown.

Run focused contract checks, affected rrd-contract tests and strict lint, documentation/navigation/inventory/workflow checks, then full candidate CI. Source-bound perturbations test denial and remain outside learning data. No fake endpoint or mock success substitutes for real-provider evidence. Research: no new third-party algorithm/library; protocol shape is this repository's own proposed selection boundary. Real endpoint proof uses the already configured experimental BF16 service, not a newly purchased provider.

Stop on new authority, embedded routing preferences, missing real evidence, altered existing route semantics or a need to skip required CI. Native dispatch, restart/uncertain effects, independently reviewed quality, training and model qualification remain later prerequisites. Journal/results and exact candidate pending.
title: Validate bounded controller endpoint choices
